# semantic-cache

> Cache LLM responses by embedding cosine similarity with an exact-key fast path, TTL, tenant namespaces, LRU eviction and explicit invalidation. Python package `trysac-semantic-cache`, import name `semantic_cache`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
